summary: Created one gold and cash-generative-miner macro-hedge idea using current Federal Reserve, industry-demand, and Newmont evidence. Gold's hedge role and miner cash generation are supported, but real yields, mean reversion, operating costs, jurisdiction, and valuation prevent a strategy or ticker-only follow-up.

evidence.claim: The FOMC held its target range at 3.5%-3.75% and said inflation remained elevated relative to its 2% objective.

evidence.source: World Gold Council Q1 2026 Gold Demand Trends
evidence.claim: First-quarter demand reached 1,231 tonnes, central banks bought 244 tonnes net, and recycling rose 5% amid record prices.
Newmont reported USD 3.1 billion of free cash flow and a USD 3.2 billion net-cash position.
Newmont reported USD 2.2 billion of second-quarter free cash flow and USD 3.4 billion of net cash while retaining full-year guidance.

daily_report_items: Researched gold and miners as a macro hedge: diversification and cash generation are supported, but real-yield, mean-reversion, cost, jurisdiction, identity, and valuation gates block a strategy.
